scope: Checks on four recorded native point-vector entries from two consecutive concave previews.
observations: Each recorded 12-point list has ascending point addresses and stored zero-based indexes. Corresponding 3D sequences match across the two previews while starting addresses differ. Source corners and some intersection points recur across both face lists.
limitations: Two previews in one process are insufficient to prove deterministic order across scenes or devices.
The recorded object addresses and inferred field layout are implementation details and are not suitable application sorting keys.
Point creation and traversal order remain unresolved.
No application code or GUI/MCP parity claim.
